An online atlas Dr. Thanapong created for the lifelong education of ophthalmologists. It explains how intraocular lenses work, from optical principle to defocus curve.
In 2026 he created the IOL Optics Atlas (iolatlas.com), an online resource for the lifelong education of ophthalmologists in intraocular lens optics.
Intraocular lens optics, computed and sourced

Eighteen interactive pages, computed in the browser: lenses classified by optical principle and depth of field, simulated defocus curves, optical bench, night halos, toric alignment, biometers and IOL formulas. Every value is linked to its source and graded by level of evidence.
Built for teaching, with a Present mode for lecture slides. It is not a substitute for manufacturer bench data or clinical trials, and it is not meant for patients to choose a lens.
